            .admin-badge-success .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-success); }
            .admin-badge-warning .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-warning); }
            .admin-badge-danger .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-danger); }
            .admin-badge-info .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-primary); }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               10. ADMIN LOGIN PAGE COMPOSITION
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-login-body {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
              min-height: 100vh;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-login-container {
              width: 100%;
              max-width: 440px;
              margin: 0 auto;
            }
            
            .admin-login-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-xl);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
              text-align: center;
            }
            
            .admin-login-brand {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              align-items: center;
            }
            
            .admin-brand-logo-wrap {
              width: 52px;
              height: 52px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-primary-border);
            }
            
            .admin-login-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            .admin-login-subtitle {
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 6px;
              padding: 4px 10px;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge.prod {
              background-color: #FEF2F2;
              color: #DC2626;
              border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge.prod .admin-env-dot {
              width: 6px;
              height: 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: #DC2626;
            }
            
            .admin-login-footer {
              margin-top: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: center;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              padding-top: var(--space-md);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
            }
            
            /* App Container */
            .admin-app {
              display: flex;
              min-height: 100vh;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-backdrop {
              display: none;
              position: fixed;
              inset: 0;
              background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
              backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
              z-index: 95;
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-backdrop.active {
              display: block;
            }
            
            /* Sidebar Navigation */
            .admin-sidebar {
              width: var(--admin-sidebar-width);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border-right: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              position: fixed;
              top: 0;
              bottom: 0;
              left: 0;
              z-index: 100;
              transition: transform var(--transition-base);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-header {
              height: var(--admin-header-height);
              padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-brand {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              font-size: var(--font-size-md);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              text-decoration: none;
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-nav {
              padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-sm);
              flex: 1;
              overflow-y: auto;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-group {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-group-label {
              font-size: 0.6875rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.06em;
              padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-2xs);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: 0.625rem var(--space-md);
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              margin-bottom: 2px;
              text-decoration: none;
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
              cursor: pointer;
              position: relative;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item svg {
              width: 18px;
              height: 18px;
              color: inherit;
              flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item.active {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item.restricted {
              opacity: 0.55;
              cursor: not-allowed;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-badge {
              font-size: 0.625rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-left: auto;
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-lock {
              margin-left: auto;
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-footer {
              padding: var(--space-md);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-user {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-avatar {
              width: 36px;
              height: 36px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-primary-border);
              flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-user-info {
              flex: 1;
              min-width: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-user-name {
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              white-space: nowrap;
              overflow: hidden;
              text-overflow: ellipsis;
            }
            
            .admin-user-role {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            /* Main Viewport Container */
            .admin-main-wrap {
              margin-left: var(--admin-sidebar-width);
              flex: 1;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              min-width: 0;
              min-height: 100vh;
            }
            
            /* Top Header Bar */
            .admin-header {
              height: var(--admin-header-height);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              padding: 0 var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              position: sticky;
              top: 0;
              z-index: 90;
            }
            
            .admin-header-left {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-menu-toggle {
              display: none;
              background: none;
              border: none;
              cursor: pointer;
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumbs {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumb-separator {
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumb-current {
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-header-right {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-session-timer {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 6px;
              padding: 4px 10px;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-session-timer.expiring {
              background-color: #FEF2F2;
              border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
              color: #DC2626;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-menu-wrap {
              position: relative;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-btn {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              padding: 4px 8px;
              background-color: transparent;
              border: 1px solid transparent;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              cursor: pointer;
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-profile-btn:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-profile-dropdown {
              display: none;
              position: absolute;
              top: calc(100% + 8px);
              right: 0;
              width: 240px;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
              z-index: 200;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-dropdown.open {
              display: block;
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-header {
              padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-roles {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              gap: 4px;
              margin-top: 4px;
            }
            
            .admin-role-badge {
              display: inline-block;
              font-size: 0.6875rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-role-badge.super-admin {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary-border);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-divider {
              height: 1px;
              background-color: var(--admin-border-subtle);
              margin: var(--space-xs) 0;
            }
            
            .admin-permission-grid {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 4px;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              padding: 4px 8px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag.wildcard {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary-border);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag.granted {
              background-color: #ECFDF5;
              color: #059669;
              border-color: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.2);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-value {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              line-height: 1.2;
              margin: 0.25rem 0;
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-subtext {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            .admin-placeholder-box, .admin-forbidden-box {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px dashed var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-xl);
              text-align: center;
              margin-top: var(--space-lg);
            }
            
            .admin-placeholder-icon, .admin-forbidden-icon {
              width: 48px;
              height: 48px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              margin: 0 auto var(--space-md);
            }
            
            /* Main Content Area */
            .admin-content {
              flex: 1;
              padding: var(--space-xl);
              max-width: 1440px;
              width: 100%;
              margin: 0 auto;
            }
            
            .admin-view-header {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: flex-start;
            }
            
            .admin-view-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            }
            
            .admin-view-desc {
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-top: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               12. ADMIN CARDS & STATS GRID
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-grid {
              display: grid;
              gap: var(--space-lg);
            }
            
            .admin-grid-4 {
              grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            }
            
            .admin-grid-2 {
              grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            
            .admin-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-xl);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
              transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-card-hover:hover {
              border-color: var(--admin-border-hover);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
              transform: translateY(-2px);
            }
            
            .admin-card-header {
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: center;
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-card-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-md);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-number {
              font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              line-height: 1.1;
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-label {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.04em;
              margin-top: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               13. DATA TABLES & AUDIT LOG PRESENTATION
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-table-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              overflow: hidden;
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-table-wrap {
              width: 100%;
              overflow-x: auto;
            }
            
            .admin-table {
              width: 100%;
              border-collapse: collapse;
              text-align: left;
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-table th {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              white-space: nowrap;
            }
            
            .admin-table td {
              padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              vertical-align: middle;
            }
            
            .admin-table tbody tr:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-hover);
            }
            
            .admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
              border-bottom: none;
            }
            
            .admin-mono-code {
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
              font-size: 0.8125rem;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               14. TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-toast-container {
              position: fixed;
              bottom: var(--space-xl);
              right: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              z-index: 1000;
              max-width: 400px;
              width: calc(100% - 2rem);
            }
            
            .admin-toast {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-left: 4px solid var(--admin-primary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              padding: var(--space-md);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              animation: toastSlideIn 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            }
            
            .admin-toast.toast-success { border-left-color: var(--admin-success); }
            .admin-toast.toast-danger  { border-left-color: var(--admin-danger); }
            .admin-toast.toast-warning { border-left-color: var(--admin-warning); }
            
            @keyframes toastSlideIn {
              from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
              to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               15. PROFILE DROPDOWN & MODALS
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-dropdown-menu {
              position: absolute;
              top: 100%;
              right: 0;
              margin-top: var(--space-xs);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
              min-width: 220px;
              z-index: 200;
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-item {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: 0.625rem var(--space-md);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
              cursor: pointer;
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-item:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               16. PREFERS-REDUCED-MOTION OVERRIDES (WCAG 2.2 AA)
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
                transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                scroll-behavior: auto !important;
              }
            
              .admin-card-hover:hover,
              .admin-btn-primary:hover,
              .admin-btn:active {
                transform: none !important;
              }
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               17. RESPONSIVE MEDIA QUERIES (1024px, 768px, 640px Breakpoints)
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            @media (max-width: 1024px) {
              .admin-grid-4 {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
              }
            }
            
            @media (max-width: 768px) {
              .admin-sidebar {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
              }
            
              .admin-sidebar.open {
                transform: translateX(0);
                box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              }
            
              .admin-main-wrap {
                margin-left: 0;
              }
            
              .admin-header {
                padding: 0 var(--space-md);
              }
            
              .admin-content {
                padding: var(--space-md);
              }
            
              .admin-grid-4, .admin-grid-2 {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
              }
            
              .otp-container {
                gap: 6px;
              }
            
              .otp-box {
                width: 44px;
                height: 52px;
                font-size: 1.25rem;
              }
            }
            
            @media (max-width: 640px) {
              .admin-login-card {
                padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md);
              }
            
              .otp-container {
                gap: 4px;
              }
            
              .otp-box {
                width: 40px;
                height: 48px;
                font-size: 1.125rem;
              }
            }
            
            /* ==========================================================================
               18. PHASE 8.7 OPERATIONAL UI COMPONENTS (Filters, Modals, Drawers, Tabs)
               ========================================================================== */
            
            /* Filter Toolbar */
            .admin-toolbar {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              gap: var(--space-md);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              padding: var(--space-md);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            }
            
            .admin-toolbar-left,
            .admin-toolbar-right {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-search-wrap {
              position: relative;
              min-width: 260px;
            }
            
            .admin-search-icon {
              position: absolute;

            .admin-search-input {

              font-family: var(--font-sans);
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);

              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);

            /* Pagination Bar */
            .admin-pagination-bar {

              justify-content: space-between;
              padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);

              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);

            .admin-pagination-controls {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-pagination-btn {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              min-width: 32px;
              height: 32px;
              padding: 0 0.5rem;
              font-family: var(--font-sans);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              font-weight: 500;
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
              cursor: pointer;
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-pagination-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-border-hover);

              background-color: var(--admin-primary);
              color: var(--admin-text-on-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary);
            }
            
            /* Operational Tabs */
            .admin-tabs-nav {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
            }
            
            .admin-tab-btn {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
              font-family: var(--font-sans);
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              font-weight: 500;
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);

              border-bottom-color: var(--admin-primary);

            /* Modal Overlay & Dialog */
            .admin-modal-backdrop {

              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              overflow: hidden;
              animation: modalPop 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            }
            
            .admin-modal-header {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-modal-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
              font-weight: 700;
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              margin: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-modal-body {
              padding: var(--space-xl);
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              line-height: var(--line-height-body);
            }
            
            .admin-modal-footer {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: flex-end;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
            }
            
            /* Detail Drawer */
            .admin-drawer-container {
              position: fixed;
              top: 0;
              right: 0;
              bottom: 0;
              width: 100%;
              max-width: 560px;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              z-index: 1050;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              border-left: 1px solid var(--admin-border);

            }

              transform: translateX(0);

            .admin-drawer-header {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-body {
              flex: 1;
              overflow-y: auto;
              padding: var(--space-xl);
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-section {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-section:last-child {
              margin-bottom: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-section-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              font-weight: 700;
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.05em;
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-property-grid {
              display: grid;
              grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr;
              gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);

            /* Empty State */

            .admin-empty-icon {

              height: 48px;
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);

            .admin-empty-title {

            /* Status Badges for Email */

            .admin-badge-status-delivered {

            .admin-badge-status-delivered .admin-status-dot { background-color: #059669; }
            
            .admin-badge-status-deferred {

              color: #D97706;
              border: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25);
            }
            .admin-badge-status-deferred .admin-status-dot { background-color: #D97706; }
            
            .admin-badge-status-failed {

            .admin-badge-status-bounced .admin-status-dot { background-color: #EA580C; }
            
            .admin-badge-status-blocked {

            .admin-badge-status-pending .admin-status-dot { background-color: #64748B; }

            }
            
            .admin-timeline-dot.primary {
              border-color: #2563EB;
              background-color: #2563EB;
            }
            
            .admin-timeline-dot.warning {
              border-color: #D97706;
              background-color: #D97706;
            }
            
            .admin-timeline-dot.danger {

              color: var(--admin-text-muted);

              font-size: 0.75rem;
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);

            .admin-investigation-section {

              font-weight: 700;
              text-transform: uppercase;

              color: var(--admin-text-muted);

              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;

               ========================================================================== */

              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              gap: 1.25rem;

            .admin-sql-status-pill {

              gap: 0.375rem;

              font-size: 0.75rem;

              font-family: var(--font-mono);
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.04em;

              background: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);

              color: #1d4ed8;
              border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;

            .admin-sql-status-pill.success {

              color: #047857;
              border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;

              color: #b91c1c;
              border: 1px solid #fecaca;
            }
            
            .admin-sql-status-pill.rejected {
              background: #fffbeb;
              color: #b45309;
              border: 1px solid #fde68a;
            }
            
            .admin-sql-status-pill.timeout {
              background: #fff1f2;
              color: #be123c;
              border: 1px solid #fecdd3;
            }
            
            .admin-sql-status-pill.committed {
              background: #ecfdf5;
              color: #047857;
              border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;
            }
            
            .admin-sql-status-pill.rolledback {
              background: #fffbeb;
              color: #b45309;
              border: 1px solid #fde68a;

            .admin-btn-warning {
              background: #d97706;
              color: #ffffff;
              border: 1px solid #b45309;
            }
            
            .admin-btn-warning:hover:not(:disabled) {
              background: #b45309;
              border-color: #92400e;
              color: #ffffff;

            }
            
            .admin-alert-warning {
              background-color: var(--admin-warning-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-warning-border);
              color: var(--admin-warning);
            }
            
            .admin-alert-success {
              background-color: var(--admin-success-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-success-border);
              color: var(--admin-success);
            }
            
            .admin-alert-info {
              background-color: var(--admin-info-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-info-border);
              color: var(--admin-info);
            }
            
            /* Status Pills */
            .admin-badge {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 6px;
              padding: 3px 10px;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              line-height: 1;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              border: 1px solid transparent;
              white-space: nowrap;
            }
            
            .admin-badge-success {
              background-color: var(--admin-success-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-success);
              border-color: var(--admin-success-border);
            }
            
            .admin-badge-warning {
              background-color: var(--admin-warning-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-warning);
              border-color: var(--admin-warning-border);
            }
            
            .admin-badge-danger {
              background-color: var(--admin-danger-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-danger);
              border-color: var(--admin-danger-border);
            }
            
            .admin-badge-info, .admin-badge-primary {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary-border);
            }
            
            .admin-badge-neutral {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border-color: var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-status-dot {
              width: 8px;
              height: 8px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              display: inline-block;
            }
            
            .admin-badge-success .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-success); }
            .admin-badge-warning .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-warning); }
            .admin-badge-danger .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-danger); }
            .admin-badge-info .admin-status-dot { background-color: var(--admin-primary); }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               10. ADMIN LOGIN PAGE COMPOSITION
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-login-body {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
              min-height: 100vh;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-login-container {
              width: 100%;
              max-width: 440px;
              margin: 0 auto;
            }
            
            .admin-login-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-xl);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
              text-align: center;
            }
            
            .admin-login-brand {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              align-items: center;
            }
            
            .admin-brand-logo-wrap {
              width: 52px;
              height: 52px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-primary-border);
            }
            
            .admin-login-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            .admin-login-subtitle {
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 6px;
              padding: 4px 10px;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge.prod {
              background-color: #FEF2F2;
              color: #DC2626;
              border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2);
            }
            
            .admin-env-badge.prod .admin-env-dot {
              width: 6px;
              height: 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: #DC2626;
            }
            
            .admin-login-footer {
              margin-top: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: center;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              padding-top: var(--space-md);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
            }
            
            /* App Container */
            .admin-app {
              display: flex;
              min-height: 100vh;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-base);
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-backdrop {
              display: none;
              position: fixed;
              inset: 0;
              background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
              backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
              z-index: 95;
            }
            
            .admin-drawer-backdrop.active {
              display: block;
            }
            
            /* Sidebar Navigation */
            .admin-sidebar {
              width: var(--admin-sidebar-width);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border-right: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              position: fixed;
              top: 0;
              bottom: 0;
              left: 0;
              z-index: 100;
              transition: transform var(--transition-base);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-header {
              height: var(--admin-header-height);
              padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-brand {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              font-size: var(--font-size-md);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              text-decoration: none;
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-nav {
              padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-sm);
              flex: 1;
              overflow-y: auto;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-group {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-group-label {
              font-size: 0.6875rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.06em;
              padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-2xs);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: 0.625rem var(--space-md);
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              margin-bottom: 2px;
              text-decoration: none;
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
              cursor: pointer;
              position: relative;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item svg {
              width: 18px;
              height: 18px;
              color: inherit;
              flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item.active {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-item.restricted {
              opacity: 0.55;
              cursor: not-allowed;
            }
            
            .admin-nav-badge {
              font-size: 0.625rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-left: auto;
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-nav-lock {
              margin-left: auto;
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-footer {
              padding: var(--space-md);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
            }
            
            .admin-sidebar-user {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-avatar {
              width: 36px;
              height: 36px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-primary-border);
              flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-user-info {
              flex: 1;
              min-width: 0;
            }
            
            .admin-user-name {
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              white-space: nowrap;
              overflow: hidden;
              text-overflow: ellipsis;
            }
            
            .admin-user-role {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            /* Main Viewport Container */
            .admin-main-wrap {
              margin-left: var(--admin-sidebar-width);
              flex: 1;
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              min-width: 0;
              min-height: 100vh;
            }
            
            /* Top Header Bar */
            .admin-header {
              height: var(--admin-header-height);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              padding: 0 var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: space-between;
              position: sticky;
              top: 0;
              z-index: 90;
            }
            
            .admin-header-left {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-menu-toggle {
              display: none;
              background: none;
              border: none;
              cursor: pointer;
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumbs {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumb-separator {
              color: var(--admin-text-subtle);
            }
            
            .admin-breadcrumb-current {
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-header-right {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-session-timer {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 6px;
              padding: 4px 10px;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-full);
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-session-timer.expiring {
              background-color: #FEF2F2;
              border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
              color: #DC2626;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-menu-wrap {
              position: relative;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-btn {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              padding: 4px 8px;
              background-color: transparent;
              border: 1px solid transparent;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              cursor: pointer;
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-profile-btn:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border-color: var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-profile-dropdown {
              display: none;
              position: absolute;
              top: calc(100% + 8px);
              right: 0;
              width: 240px;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
              z-index: 200;
            }
            
            .admin-profile-dropdown.open {
              display: block;
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-header {
              padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-roles {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              gap: 4px;
              margin-top: 4px;
            }
            
            .admin-role-badge {
              display: inline-block;
              font-size: 0.6875rem;
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            .admin-role-badge.super-admin {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary-border);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-divider {
              height: 1px;
              background-color: var(--admin-border-subtle);
              margin: var(--space-xs) 0;
            }
            
            .admin-permission-grid {
              display: flex;
              flex-wrap: wrap;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag {
              display: inline-flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: 4px;
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              padding: 4px 8px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag.wildcard {
              background-color: var(--admin-primary-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-primary);
              border-color: var(--admin-primary-border);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
            }
            
            .admin-perm-tag.granted {
              background-color: #ECFDF5;
              color: #059669;
              border-color: rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.2);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-value {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              line-height: 1.2;
              margin: 0.25rem 0;
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-subtext {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
            }
            
            .admin-placeholder-box, .admin-forbidden-box {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px dashed var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-3xl) var(--space-xl);
              text-align: center;
              margin-top: var(--space-lg);
            }
            
            .admin-placeholder-icon, .admin-forbidden-icon {
              width: 48px;
              height: 48px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              justify-content: center;
              margin: 0 auto var(--space-md);
            }
            
            /* Main Content Area */
            .admin-content {
              flex: 1;
              padding: var(--space-xl);
              max-width: 1440px;
              width: 100%;
              margin: 0 auto;
            }
            
            .admin-view-header {
              margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: flex-start;
            }
            
            .admin-view-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            }
            
            .admin-view-desc {
              font-size: var(--font-size-base);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              margin-top: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               12. ADMIN CARDS & STATS GRID
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-grid {
              display: grid;
              gap: var(--space-lg);
            }
            
            .admin-grid-4 {
              grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            }
            
            .admin-grid-2 {
              grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
            
            .admin-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              padding: var(--space-xl);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
              transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-card-hover:hover {
              border-color: var(--admin-border-hover);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
              transform: translateY(-2px);
            }
            
            .admin-card-header {
              display: flex;
              justify-content: space-between;
              align-items: center;
              margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
            }
            
            .admin-card-title {
              font-size: var(--font-size-md);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-number {
              font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              letter-spacing: -0.02em;
              line-height: 1.1;
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
            }
            
            .admin-stat-label {
              font-size: var(--font-size-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-muted);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
              text-transform: uppercase;
              letter-spacing: 0.04em;
              margin-top: 0.25rem;
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               13. DATA TABLES & AUDIT LOG PRESENTATION
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-table-card {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              overflow: hidden;
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-table-wrap {
              width: 100%;
              overflow-x: auto;
            }
            
            .admin-table {
              width: 100%;
              border-collapse: collapse;
              text-align: left;
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
            }
            
            .admin-table th {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
              padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              white-space: nowrap;
            }
            
            .admin-table td {
              padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
              border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-border-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              vertical-align: middle;
            }
            
            .admin-table tbody tr:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-hover);
            }
            
            .admin-table tbody tr:last-child td {
              border-bottom: none;
            }
            
            .admin-mono-code {
              font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
              font-size: 0.8125rem;
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              padding: 2px 6px;
              border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               14. TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-toast-container {
              position: fixed;
              bottom: var(--space-xl);
              right: var(--space-xl);
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              gap: var(--space-xs);
              z-index: 1000;
              max-width: 400px;
              width: calc(100% - 2rem);
            }
            
            .admin-toast {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-left: 4px solid var(--admin-primary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-md);
              padding: var(--space-md);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              animation: toastSlideIn 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            }
            
            .admin-toast.toast-success { border-left-color: var(--admin-success); }
            .admin-toast.toast-danger  { border-left-color: var(--admin-danger); }
            .admin-toast.toast-warning { border-left-color: var(--admin-warning); }
            
            @keyframes toastSlideIn {
              from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
              to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               15. PROFILE DROPDOWN & MODALS
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            .admin-dropdown-menu {
              position: absolute;
              top: 100%;
              right: 0;
              margin-top: var(--space-xs);
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-surface-elevated);
              border: 1px solid var(--admin-border);
              border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
              box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
              padding: var(--space-xs);
              min-width: 220px;
              z-index: 200;
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-item {
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              gap: var(--space-sm);
              padding: 0.625rem var(--space-md);
              font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
              color: var(--admin-text-secondary);
              border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
              cursor: pointer;
              transition: all var(--transition-fast);
            }
            
            .admin-dropdown-item:hover {
              background-color: var(--admin-bg-subtle);
              color: var(--admin-text-primary);
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               16. PREFERS-REDUCED-MOTION OVERRIDES (WCAG 2.2 AA)
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
                transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                scroll-behavior: auto !important;
              }
            
              .admin-card-hover:hover,
              .admin-btn-primary:hover,
              .admin-btn:active {
                transform: none !important;
              }
            }
            
            /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
               17. RESPONSIVE MEDIA QUERIES (1024px, 768px, 640px Breakpoints)
               -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            @media (max-width: 1024px) {
              .admin-grid-4 {

                _renderHeaderProfile() {
                  const user = window.AdminAuth.currentUser;
                  const roles = window.AdminAuth.roles;
                  if (!user) return;
            
                  const initials = (user.fullName || user.email || 'A')
                    .split(' ')
                    .map(n => n[0])
                    .join('')
                    .toUpperCase()
                    .slice(0, 2);
            
                  const avatarEl = document.getElementById('adminAvatarInitials');
                  if (avatarEl) avatarEl.textContent = initials;
            
                  const headerNameEl = document.getElementById('adminHeaderName');
                  if (headerNameEl) headerNameEl.textContent = user.fullName || user.email;
            
                  const sidebarNameEl = document.getElementById('adminSidebarName');
                  if (sidebarNameEl) sidebarNameEl.textContent = user.fullName || user.email;
            
                  const primaryRole = (typeof roles[0] === 'string' ? roles[0] : roles[0]?.name) || (window.AdminAuth.isSuperAdmin ? 'SUPER_ADMIN' : 'ADMIN');
                  const sidebarRoleEl = document.getElementById('adminSidebarRole');
                  if (sidebarRoleEl) sidebarRoleEl.textContent = primaryRole;
            
                  const dropdownNameEl = document.getElementById('adminDropdownName');
                  if (dropdownNameEl) dropdownNameEl.textContent = user.fullName || user.name || 'Super Administrator';
            
                  const dropdownEmailEl = document.getElementById('adminDropdownEmail');
                  if (dropdownEmailEl) dropdownEmailEl.textContent = user.email;
            
                  const rolesContainer = document.getElementById('adminDropdownRoles');
                  if (rolesContainer) {
                    rolesContainer.innerHTML = roles.map(r => {
                      const roleName = typeof r === 'string' ? r : (r.name || r.slug || 'ADMIN');
                      const isSuper = roleName === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || window.AdminAuth.isSuperAdmin;
                      return `<span class="admin-role-badge ${isSuper ? 'super-admin' : ''}">${this._escape(roleName)}</span>`;
                    }).join('') || '<span class="admin-role-badge super-admin">SUPER_ADMIN</span>';
                  }
                }

                  const navContainer = document.getElementById('adminSidebarNav');
                  if (!navContainer) return;

                  for (const group of NAV_SCHEMA) {
                    html += `<div class="admin-nav-group">`;
                    html += `<div class="admin-nav-group-label">${this._escape(group.group)}</div>`;
            
                    for (const item of group.items) {
                      const hasAccess = item.permission === null || window.AdminAuth.hasPermission(item.permission);
                      const iconSvg = ICONS[item.icon] || ICONS.dashboard;
            
                      if (hasAccess) {

                            <span>${this._escape(item.label)}</span>

                            <span class="admin-nav-lock">${ICONS.lock}</span>

                  window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => this._handleHashRoute());
            
                  const profileBtn = document.getElementById('adminProfileBtn');
                  const profileDropdown = document.getElementById('adminProfileDropdown');
            
                  if (profileBtn && profileDropdown) {
                    profileBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      profileDropdown.classList.toggle('open');
                    });
            
                    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
                      profileDropdown.classList.remove('open');
                    });
                  }
            
                  const logoutBtns = document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="logout"]');
                  logoutBtns.forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      btn.disabled = true;
                      // Invariant: Immediately wipe in-memory SQL history & saved queries upon logout
                      this.sqlHistoryState.entries = [];
                      this.sqlHistoryState.expandedIds.clear();
                      this.sqlSavedQueriesState.queries = [];
                      this.sqlSavedQueriesState.expandedIds.clear();
                      this.toast('Signing out of ZdexCloud Operations...', 'info');
                      await window.AdminAuth.logout();
                    });
                  });
            
                  // Synchronize with AdminAuth changes (logout across tabs, account switching, session refresh)
                  if (window.AdminAuth && window.AdminAuth.subscribe) {
                    window.AdminAuth.subscribe(({ user }) => {
                      if (!user) {
                        // Unauthenticated state / logout / session expiration: wipe in-memory history & saved queries
                        this.sqlHistoryState.entries = [];
                        this.sqlHistoryState.expandedIds.clear();
                        this.sqlSavedQueriesState.queries = [];
                        this.sqlSavedQueriesState.expandedIds.clear();
                      } else {
                        const currentAdminId = user.id || user.userId || user.email;
                        if (currentAdminId) {
                          this._loadSqlHistory();
                          this._loadSqlSavedQueries();
                          if (this.currentSection === 'sql-runner') {
                            this._renderSqlSavedQueriesList();
                            this._renderSqlHistoryList();
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    });
                  }
            
                  const menuToggle = document.getElementById('adminMenuToggle');
                  const sidebar = document.getElementById('adminSidebar');
                  const backdrop = document.getElementById('adminDrawerBackdrop');
            
                  if (menuToggle && sidebar && backdrop) {
                    const toggleDrawer = () => {
                      sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
                      backdrop.classList.toggle('active');
                    };
            
                    menuToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);
                    backdrop.addEventListener('click', toggleDrawer);
                  }
            
                  const resetActivity = () => {
                    this.idleSecondsRemaining = 900;
                  };
                  window.addEventListener('mousemove', resetActivity, { passive: true });
                  window.addEventListener('keydown', resetActivity, { passive: true });
                  window.addEventListener('click', resetActivity, { passive: true });
            
                  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                      if (document.getElementById('adminDbFilterModal')) {
                        this._closeDbFilterModal();
                      } else if (document.getElementById('adminDbAddRowDrawerBackdrop')) {
                        this._closeAddRowDrawer();
                      } else if (document.getElementById('adminDbEditRowDrawerBackdrop')) {

                _startIdleCountdown() {

                    if (this.auditState.action) params.append('action', this.auditState.action);
                    if (this.auditState.status) params.append('status', this.auditState.status);
                    const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/admin/audit-logs/export?${params.toString()}`, {
                      credentials: 'include'
                    });
            
                    if (!res.ok) {
                      throw new Error(`Export failed with HTTP ${res.status}`);
                    }
            
                    const blob = await res.blob();
                    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = url;
                    a.download = `audit-export-${Date.now()}.${format}`;
                    document.body.appendChild(a);
                    a.click();
                    a.remove();
                    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    this.toast('Audit export downloaded successfully.', 'success');

                    this.toast(err.message || 'Audit export failed', 'danger');

                async loadSettlements() {
                  const tbody = document.getElementById('settlementTableBody');

                  try {
                    const queryParams = new URLSearchParams({
                      page: String(this.settlementState.page),
                      pageSize: String(this.settlementState.pageSize)
                    });
                    if (this.settlementState.search) queryParams.set('search', this.settlementState.search);
                    if (this.settlementState.reconciliationStatus) queryParams.set('reconciliationStatus', this.settlementState.reconciliationStatus);
            
                    const res = await window.AdminApi.get(`/admin/operations/billing/settlements?${queryParams.toString()}`);
                    const data = res.data;
                    this.settlementState.items = data.items || [];
                    this.settlementState.total = data.total || 0;
            
                    if (this.settlementState.items.length === 0) {

                    try {
                      const res = await window.AdminApi.get(`/admin/operations/billing/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);

                      const totalHits = (data.payments?.length || 0) + (data.refunds?.length || 0) + (data.subscriptions?.length || 0) + (data.settlements?.length || 0) + (data.users?.length || 0);

                      // Settlements Section

                            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.375rem;">
                              ${data.settlements.map(st => `
                                <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0.625rem 0.875rem;background:var(--admin-bg-base);border:1px solid var(--admin-border);border-radius:var(--radius-xs);">

                      html += `</div>`;
                      resultsContainer.innerHTML = html;
